cover.sub: The containers aren't the problem. See #5.

reasons.head: You prep the same meal every week
reasons.sub: The same chicken and rice gets old fast, so by Wednesday you're ordering takeout.

reasons.head: Your prep only covers lunch
reasons.sub: Breakfast and dinner are left to chance, and that's where the plan falls apart.

reasons.head: Your food goes bad by Thursday
reasons.sub: Cooked food only keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge, so Friday's box ends up in the trash.

reasons.head: You never plan your snacks
reasons.sub: When hunger hits at 3 p.m., the vending machine beats the box in your bag.

reasons.head: You eyeball every portion
reasons.sub: Scooping rice, oil and sauce by eye means every box can hold way more than you think.
